'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Vince Hutchins DS Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vince Hutchins]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith|SE-D-darthvaderdarklordofthesith.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
